summary: Zentek Ltd., a Canadian graphene technology company, reported via Form 6-K that Nasdaq will delist its common shares from the Nasdaq Capital Market due to non-compliance with the minimum bid price requirement. Trading will be suspended at the open on September 2, 2026, and shares will transition to OTC Markets Group, with an application for OTCQX quotation pending. Zentek will appeal the delisting determination through a hearing, which will not stay the suspension. The TSX Venture Exchange listing (ZEN) remains unaffected as the primary listing. No shareholder action is required. Watch for the hearing outcome and potential impact on OTC liquidity.
